PRENATAL CYTOGENETICS LABORATORY REPORT
[redacted location] Regional Genetics Laboratory

PATIENT INFORMATION
Patient Name: [redacted name]
Date of Birth: [redacted date]
Medical Record Number: [redacted ID]
Specimen Type: Chorionic villus sample
Date Collected: [redacted date]
Date Received: [redacted date]
Date Reported: [redacted date]

CLINICAL INDICATION
Prenatal testing

TEST PERFORMED
Interphase Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization (FISH) Analysis

METHODOLOGY
Interphase FISH was performed on uncultured chorionic villus cells using a chromosome 18 centromere-specific probe (D18Z1). A minimum of 100 interphase nuclei were scored for the presence of chromosome 18 signals.

Probe Details:
- D18Z1 (18p11.1-q11.1): Spectrum Green
- Manufacturer: Abbott Molecular

RESULT: ABNORMAL

FISH FINDINGS
Chromosome 18 Analysis:
- Total nuclei analyzed: 105
- Nuclei with 3 signals: 96 (91.4%)
- Nuclei with 2 signals: 9 (8.6%)

Result: nuc ish (D18Z1)x3[96/105]

INTERPRETATION
The FISH analysis demonstrates three chromosome 18 signals in 91.4% of nuclei examined, which is consistent with trisomy 18 (Edwards syndrome) in the fetal cells. The presence of 8.6% cells with two signals likely represents maternal cell contamination or technical artifact.

This result confirms trisomy 18 and is consistent with previous QF-PCR results.

CLINICAL CORRELATION
Trisomy 18 is associated with severe intellectual disability, congenital malformations affecting multiple organ systems, and poor prognosis. The majority of affected pregnancies result in spontaneous loss, and liveborn infants typically have a median survival of less than two weeks.

RECOMMENDATIONS
1. Full karyotype analysis from cultured chorionic villus cells is in progress and will be reported separately to confirm the diagnosis and rule out structural abnormalities
2. Genetic counseling is recommended to discuss the implications of this diagnosis
3. If pregnancy termination is elected, tissue submission is recommended for confirmation of findings
4. Maternal age-related recurrence risk counseling should be provided

LIMITATIONS
This test is limited to detection of numerical abnormalities of chromosome 18. Structural rearrangements, mosaicism below the detection threshold, and abnormalities of other chromosomes would not be detected by this targeted FISH analysis.

Authorized by: [redacted name], PhD, FACMG
Laboratory Director
